opis: The cosy kitchen from the reference picture, in warm late-afternoon light. Around the big wooden table sit the OWL, the BUNNY and the FOX. On the table three plates with half-eaten sandwiches (bread, butter and yellow cheese), crumbs, three cups of milk. The OWL holds an open picture book with both wings and reads it aloud; on the open pages a simple picture of a white egg in a straw nest. The BUNNY leans in close with his chin on his paws, listening with shining eyes; the FOX listens too, smiling. Calm, happy and cosy - the promised story at last.
